_how: Each engine is a command list. {prompt_file} becomes the path of a file holding the prompt, {prompt_text} the prompt itself, {project} the project path. Use absolute executable paths on Windows. Probe every engine before a long run: python run_program.py probe --project PATH --engine NAME
_independence: R2 and R5 judge the work. Put them on a different model family than the one that builds (R3), and not a weaker one. The machine gates still decide pass or fail.
